name: refund_request
description: Protected. Ask for a refund of a completed payment to this service. The rules decide: refunded, declined with a reason, or sent to an officer. First call returns a confirmation_id: read back which payment and why, hear a clear yes, then call again with the same arguments and the confirmation_id.

payment_ref.description: The end of the payment reference or transaction code if the caller gives it; empty means the latest payment to this service

reason.description: The caller's reason in a few words, for example found the old ID, paid twice

confirmation_id.description: Empty the first time; after the caller says yes, the confirmation_id you were given
